The coat featured a structured collar and gold-tone buttons, marking a return to a timeless wardrobe staple for the season.

stories.title: Nita Ambani wears diamond earrings to Diwali bash
stories.summary: Nita Ambani attended a Diwali party wearing diamond earrings estimated to be worth millions of dollars. Jewellery expert Julia Chafe analysed the craftsmanship of the pieces, which are reportedly valuable enough to purchase a luxury apartment. The earrings were worn for a festive celebration in Mumbai.

stories.title: GIVA raises Rs 975 crore for retail expansion
stories.summary: Jewellery brand GIVA has raised more than $100 million in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management. The company plans to use the capital to strengthen its leadership, improve manufacturing, and expand its physical store footprint to over 1,000 outlets within five years.

stories.title: NMDC auctions Panna diamonds
stories.summary: State-owned miner NMDC auctioned 2,050 carats of diamonds from its Panna mine in Madhya Pradesh. An 8.12-carat stone fetched the highest bid of Rs 57 lakh. The four-day event drew 60 buyers, primarily from Mumbai and Surat, indicating sustained interest in the domestic diamond trade.

stories.title: Amit Shah calls for lab-grown diamond leadership
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has advocated for India to take a leadership position in the global lab-grown diamond value chain. The statement comes as the domestic industry seeks to scale production and capture a larger share of the international market for synthetic stones.

stories.title: Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds secures funding
stories.summary: Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds has raised Rs 275 crore in a funding round led by its principal promoters. The company is currently expanding its retail presence, having recently reached a milestone of 100 stores across 45 cities in India.

stories.title: Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds hits 100-store mark
stories.summary: Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds has reached 100 stores across 45 cities in India. The expansion follows a recent funding round of Rs 275 crore led by the company's principal promoters to support its retail growth strategy.

stories.title: Imitation jewellery exports rise 74 percent
stories.summary: India's imitation jewellery exports grew by 74.52 percent in the first half of the 2026-27 fiscal year, reaching $54.96 million. Industry members attributed the increase to higher US tariffs on Chinese goods, which boosted demand for affordable, fashion-driven products from Indian manufacturers.

stories.title: So/Facet raises seed funding for retail brand
stories.summary: So/Facet has raised Rs 10 crore in seed funding to develop a premium retail brand for lab-grown diamond jewellery. The company aims to establish a presence in the growing synthetic stone market through its new retail venture.

stories.title: Dubai and Jaipur jewellery groups sign partnership
stories.summary: The Dubai Jewellery Group and the Jewellers Association Jaipur have signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance their strategic partnership. The agreement aims to foster collaboration between the two regions to support trade and business development in the jewellery sector.

stories.title: The mini-bag trend returns
stories.summary: Luxury houses including Chanel, Dior, and Celine are reviving the artisanal mini-bag. Fashion commentators suggest the trend serves as an anti-tote alternative for those weary of carrying heavy shoulder bags. The small accessories have recently been spotted on various high-profile figures.

stories.title: Fall and winter 2026 handbag trends
stories.summary: The fall and winter 2026 season saw a focus on sophomore collections and reduced aesthetics. Designer Pieter Mulier noted a shift toward simplicity for his final show at Alaïa, prioritising clothes over accessories. The season featured a variety of ready-to-wear and bag trends for consumers.

stories.title: Evaluating designer handbag investments
stories.summary: Fashion history suggests that certain designer handbags retain value long after purchase. Iconic styles like the Gucci Jackie and Dior Lady Dior have remained popular for decades. Determining which new designs will become long-term investments remains a challenge in a market driven by seasonal trends.

stories.title: Styling accessories for fall
stories.summary: Accessories emerged as a primary focus for fall styling, with collections emphasising personal expression. Trends include layering charms on necklaces and repurposing silk scarves as waist cummerbunds. The approach encourages using small items to alter the character of existing wardrobe staples.

stories.title: Tiffany and Co revives 1962 bracelet design
stories.summary: Tiffany and Co has re-established a 1962 bracelet design as a contemporary favourite. While fashion trends often lose momentum quickly, the company continues to rely on its archive of classic goods to maintain consumer interest in its permanent collections.

stories.summary: Hillary Sarah Andoh of HSA PR says Ghana's fashion industry needs more than creative talent to succeed. She told the Black Star Fashion Week 2026 Summit that limited financing and weak business structures restrict growth. The industry is currently advised to focus on formal organisation to compete internationally.

stories.summary: The University of Mississippi has registered Fashion Hour, a new student-led club designed to build professional networks. stories.summary: The Black Business Professionals of Southeast Texas will host a networking fashion show on Nov. 7 in Beaumont.
